decree_259_rules.rule: Registrations for assignment of classes/turmas and substitute work periods are open from 7 to 13 October 2025 for the 2026 school year.
If a titular or substitute teacher does not register as required, the school director automatically registers the teacher at the unit where the post is allocated.
During registration, the teacher opts for supplemental workload and Art/Physical Education specialists confirm or change workload for 2026.

Decree 289/2025 adds an exceptional 6-7 November 2025 window for Art/Physical Education specialists to confirm/change workload, with school-direction processing and delivery of the signed list on 10 November 2025.
School direction performs registrations through the municipal portal, including teachers exercising other functions or absent under any title.
Assignment fields are Educação Infantil, Ensino Fundamental, Educação Especial, Arte and Educação Física.
Teachers accumulating posts make distinct registrations at each school where the respective post is allocated.
Teachers who take office in 2026 register on the first day of exercise and are included in the initial classification.
School direction must convene teachers and record convocations and related decisions in the school minutes book for control and administrative transparency.
Service time is counted through 30 June 2025 and is treated as a title under LC 461/2009 art. 33.

For classification, absence days are deducted except maternity, adoption, paternity, legally mandatory services, organ donation, blood donation, falta abonada, licença-prêmio, nojo, gala and health leave.
Service time and titles use the exact point schedule materialized in scoring.
Titular and substitute teachers are classified in descending score order within their respective field of work.

School-unit classification is posted by 14 October 2025, unit appeal is 16 October, post-appeal result is 17 October, delivery is 20 October by 16:00; general classification is published 22 October and general appeal is 24 October through Limeira Digital RH protocol.
Appeals have no suspensive or retroactive effect; no late document attachment is allowed; stable CLT teachers register at their frequency-control units; the decree is effective upon publication.

sme_operational_rules.rule: Teachers indicate available classes/turmas in exact preference order.

sme_operational_rules.source_article_citation: Resolução SME 08/2025 art. 30 as quoted/cited by SME page
sme_operational_rules.rule: A teacher without the necessary requirements for the assigned class must give it up and may not receive a new assignment in the same employment contract.
Operational modality order is Educação Especial, Arte, Educação Física, Ensino Fundamental, Educação Infantil.
In the current assignment phase, a teacher assigned in a modality cannot decline that class in favor of another class in the same modality.
During the school year, a teacher who declines an assigned class cannot participate again in assignments in the declined modality.

sme_operational_rules.source_article_citation: Resolução SME 08/2025 art. 23 caput and §1 as quoted/cited by SME page
sme_operational_rules.rule: Thirty consecutive or interpolated absence days terminate the contract and bar a new assignment in the same contract; absences during multiple short assignments accumulate toward 30 days.

sme_operational_rules.source_article_citation: Resolução SME 08/2025 art. 23 §2 as quoted/cited by SME page
sme_operational_rules.rule: A PSS 04/2025 teacher who voluntarily gives up an assigned class/aula may indicate a new class/aula in another modality for which the teacher was approved only after 45 days from the withdrawal date.
Each Educação Infantil class has 2 Arte lessons, 2 Educação Física lessons and 1 Linguagens e Tecnologias lesson.
Each Ensino Fundamental class has 2 Arte lessons, 2 Educação Física lessons and 2 Linguagens e Tecnologias lessons.

sme_operational_rules.source_article_citation: Resolução SME 08/2025 art. 11 §5(b) as quoted/cited by SME page
sme_operational_rules.rule: Linguagens e Tecnologias indication requires training presented to the school director; the page states that this training may be presented during the first semester of 2026.
For extracurricular workshops, training and/or experience must be proven with documents presented to the school director.
